rv.q: Although I was baffled by this play, I would like to see it again.
If you like “Theater of the Absurd”, then this show is for you!

cn.t: This 1919 absurdist dark comedy divides critics with its hodgepodge of existentialism, burlesque, and clownlike characters—some find profundity in the chaos, while others are simply baffled by its mix of humor and depression.
